response.justification: Candidate is a versatile, experienced software craftsman but lacks the core requirements for this role: no substantive C++ experience (only brief C/C++ work at National Instruments over a decade ago and a bachelor's thesis project), no Windows-platform development background, no SQL Server/Oracle depth, and no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure. His recent and primary expertise is in TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and web/mobile full-stack development.
strengths: Strong overall software engineering track record with 15+ years of diverse experience
Demonstrated CI/CD, TDD, and dev-ops infrastructure skills
Excellent communication skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source leadership
concerns: Virtually no recent hands-on C++ experience (last C/C++ role was 2014-2015)
No evidence of Windows platform development experience
No fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain knowledge

key_factors.factor: No capital markets/fixed income domain experience
No SQL Server/Oracle or Windows platform experience
